reason: I won't set up a wallet or hold USDC for a business purchase, so this is closed to me before I look at anything else. Even without that, a contest where everyone but the winner works for free feels like spec work and I don't want my name on it.
objection: It's USDC on Solana, and I don't do crypto. On top of that, paying only the top entries is spec work, and it's an unaudited product from one person.
would_change_my_mind: Pay by card or invoice in dollars with no wallet, plus an independent audit and a fee for every submitter who meets the bar, not only the winner.
